messages.author: 390d07da5c3432ef
messages.subject: Repeated Measures design for MSstatsTMT
parts:
Hi MSstats group,

I have performed a multiplex TMT experiment in which I have made repeated measurements of some biological samples.

Our paper is currently under review and available online as a preprint: 
https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.08.06.239517v1

We performed a 16-plex experiment three times. In each experiment, we analyzed 2 mice -- a WT and Mutant mouse. In each experiment, we measured 7 subcellular fractions prepared from each of the two mice 1x. The remaining 2 channels in each experiment were reserved for analysis of  technical replicates of a pooled quality control sample for normalization. Previously I analyzed my data with the 'Sum + IRS + EdgeR' approach as you describe in your 2020 paper. Now, I would like to use MSstats as I acknowledge that it is the more appropriate tool.

But currently, I don't think MSstatsTMT this supports my experimental design.  I wrote a post on the `MSstatsTMT` github which gives a better description of my experimental design. I had not read your paper when I posted the issue however. So when I saw your 2020 paper online, I closed this issue, and read your paper. It answered may of my questions.

I wrote some code exposing the protein-wise modeling and statistical comparisons performed internally by MSstatsTMT so that I could try to understand what was going on and to try and pass a different model to accommodate my design. But, I still am struggling to perform the comparison I am interested in. Which is the comparison between the conditional means of WT and MUT mice adjusted for differences in bioFraction. Previously, I used a model of the form: (Abundance) ~ Fraction + Condition in EdgeR to assess this comparison. 

Would you be willing to collaborate to try and make MSstatsTMT compatible with my repeated measures design?

Best,
Tyler
